class.name: DebugReplicator
class.brief_description: The debug tools' network link for one player.
class.description: One sits under every [PlayerController] (named [code]DebugReplicator[/code]), on the server and on the owning client, so its remote calls have the same path on both ends and only that client may use them. - Console: a client's [constant ConsoleManager.FLAG_SERVER] commands and cheats travel up as text and run on the server as that player; their output travels back. - Gameplay debugger: the client tells the server what it looks at and which categories are on; the server collects those categories every [code]application/game_framework/debug/gameplay_debugger_refresh_interval[/code] seconds and sends them to that client only. For the server's own player nothing goes over the network.

method.name: client_output
method.description: Remote call: console output from the server.

method.name: client_receive_view
method.description: Remote call: collected gameplay debugger data from the server.

method.name: get_player_controller
method.description: The controller this replicator belongs to.

method.name: get_view_data
method.description: The last data the server sent: category name -> that category's collected [Dictionary].

method.name: get_view_data_age
method.description: Seconds since the last data arrived, or [code]-1[/code] before any did.

method.name: get_view_data_target
method.description: The node path the last data is for.

method.name: request_exec
method.description: Runs a console line on the server as this player.

method.name: request_view
method.description: Asks the server to collect [param categories] for the node at [param target] (or to stop, with [param active] [code]false[/code]).

method.name: send_output
method.description: Server: shows text in this player's console.

method.name: server_exec
method.description: Remote call: a console line from the owning client.

method.name: server_set_view
method.description: Remote call: what the owning client wants to see.
